actual_native_exit: separate int or NULL, never proof-error mapped to native exit

HTTP_fields.upstream: attempt/admitted before RoundTrip; dispatched immediately before original RoundTrip; actual response headers/consumed Body separately; received API ingress count and raw pairing
HTTP_fields.proxy: received network attempt already happened; admission before original handler; refused attempt and actual write result retained
HTTP_fields.per_write: requested raw bytes, actual n, accepted prefix, error; NOT transport complete/client received
HTTP_fields.headers: handler committed header snapshot vs actual upstream client-received headers distinct; auto Date/ContentLength/ContentType and CLI received values NULL if unobserved
HTTP_fields.completion: only after actual Body.Close or handler return; complete accounting alone not qualification; errors/overflow/partial writes reject
HTTP_fields.stop: first overflow closes only owned listeners/connections; no handler t.Fatal, no bare-PID stop added; original 15s context and enclosing owned Job remain; unrelated handlers not touched
